name: charter-showcase-go
description: The showcase API in Go: every Fern feature charter uses, in one small API, with the generated SDKs tested against it. npm run check is every local check; the steps are the scripts below, in the order you run them: each is charter-ts <step>, which reads charter.config.ts.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run spec:check && npm run test:native && npm run test:workerd
